answer: Panel approvals are aggregated as a sparse threshold signature where the signer set is chosen by a public rule rather than by the candidate, so a candidate cannot hand-pick the jury that reviews it. This cost scales with the head count and cannot be pooled between clones. A farm cannot pick its own whisper, cannot satisfy the harbor with one branch, and cannot reuse the jade that chose last time: the whisper, the harbor and the jade are all outside its control. The signer set is chosen externally and rotates every epoch.
